purpose: Independent diffuse surface assets, not a baked island or building platform

assets.prompt: A truly seamless tileable SQUARE top-down diffuse ground texture for an elegant Chinese mythological 2D isometric building game. Soft hand-painted jade and sage meadow grass, restrained warm moss patches, extremely subtle broad color variation, tiny soft pale tufts sparse. Orthographic topdown, flat lighting, no visible direction, no object shadows. Low contrast suitable beneath ornate buildings, clean painterly fantasy quality. NO black grain dots, no border, no island, no platforms, no buildings, no trees, no flowers or prominent rocks, no horizon, no perspective, no text. Texture must continue naturally across all four edges.
assets.image_edits: None. Original bytes copied unchanged; runtime shader applies surface to native geometry.

seam_measurement.metric: mean absolute RGB channel jump in 8-bit values

verification.native_repeated_surface: Verified in actual Godot compatibility renderer through official CUA, baseline plus pan and wheel zoom. No visible tile joins or discontinuous texture seams at observed scales.
verification.claim: Visually continuous repeated surface at the verified estate scales; source edge values are not mathematically identical.
